# Syed Saad Ur Rahman

> AI engineer and open-source builder. Author of Norn, a persistent-memory MCP server for AI agents, live on npm. Ships agentic systems and full-stack SaaS to production. Contributing engineer on a Guinness World Record team in agentic AI; winner of the NGIT Project Expo 2025. Based in Hyderabad, India.

## About
- Name: Syed Saad Ur Rahman
- Role: AI Engineer, open-source MCP builder, full-stack developer
- Education: B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering, Neil Gogte Institute of Technology (NGIT), 2024 to 2027; Diploma in Computer Science, Pallavi Engineering College
- Location: Hyderabad, India
- Focus: MCP and agent infrastructure, applied AI, full-stack SaaS

## Flagship (open source)
- Norn (https://norn-web-three.vercel.app): persistent-memory MCP server for AI agents, published to npm as @samad001z/norn-server (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@samad001z/norn-server) and @samad001z/norn-core. Two-stage conflict detection (embedding-similarity gate plus NLI model), a conflict-review UI, and a live fleet-monitoring dashboard with SSE streaming and a real-time orbital agent map. 89/89 tests passing. Works with any MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor, and others).

## Selected work (live)
- Cracked AI (https://crackedai.in): the AI placement coach for Indian engineers. Adaptive skill diagnostic (DSA, aptitude, OS, DBMS, CN, verbal), AI mock interviews with instant scoring, a live voice coach for spoken interview practice, and company packs for TCS NQT, Infosys SP, and Wipro NLTH. Stack: LLM, Voice AI, React, FastAPI, Supabase.
- Van Lavino (https://van-lavino.vercel.app): a full café/restaurant SaaS. QR-code table ordering, Razorpay payments, realtime order updates, a staff order dashboard, and a multi-branch admin panel. Stack: React, TypeScript, Supabase, Razorpay.
- TenderIQ: an agentic AI system for automated tender evaluation that pipelines unstructured procurement documents through an LLM reasoning layer to surface structured insights. Stack: Python, LLM, PDF pipeline.

## Other projects
- Bytes of Joy: cloud-kitchen ordering platform for a home bakery in Hyderabad; first production deployment with real end users.
- Vita: React Native AI health companion; Gemini OCR with Pydantic-validated extraction, FastAPI backend, doctor QR-share.
- BasketIQ: cross-platform grocery price-comparison app; Expo/React Native, FastAPI, Supabase with pgvector, Gemini API.
- FasalDoc: computer-vision model for early plant disease detection from a single leaf image.
- TruthLens: multi-modal misinformation detection (LLM reasoning, digital forensics, rPPG-based deepfake detection).
- Construction Co. website: production corporate website shipped to a paying client.

## Recognition
- Guinness World Record, Agentic AI Hackathon (2025), contributing engineer.
- Winner, NGIT Project Expo 2025.
